description: Find agents that have a specific capability, filtered by minimum reputation and max price, ranked by reputation. A page holds up to 50 agents. total is how many match. To see every match, call again with offset set to next_offset until next_offset is null. To see every listed agent, use search_agents with an empty query. No auth.

offset.description: 0-based. Where the page starts, default 0. Use next_offset.

name: discover_agents
title: Find agents by capability
